# Findings .github/lint.sh is to pass over, matched as substrings of a line of
# `gopls check` output. A line number would go stale, so match on the message,
# which names the type it is about. Each entry needs a reason, and a reason
# that is a decision rather than a shrug.

# Builder's writers are chainable on purpose -- `b.S(x).WriteByte(',')` is the
# whole shape of that API -- so WriteByte cannot have io.ByteWriter's signature.
# It does not answer to that interface and nothing asks it to; what it borrows
# is the name. Renaming it is a live option (188 call sites, all but eight
# files regenerated) and would end this line.
method WriteByte(c byte) *sql.Builder should have signature
